title: Concavity and Inflection Points of a Quartic
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the intervals of concavity and inflection points for f(x) = x^4 - 4x^3 + 10.
finalAnswer: \text{Concave Up on } (-\infty, 0) \cup (2, \infty); \; \text{Concave Down on } (0, 2); \; \text{Inflection Points at } (0, 10) \text{ and } (2, -6)

steps.title: Determine Sign of f''(x) and Points of Inflection
steps.mathExpression: x < 0 \implies f'' > 0 \text{ (CU)}; \quad 0 < x < 2 \implies f'' < 0 \text{ (CD)}; \quad x > 2 \implies f'' > 0 \text{ (CU)}
steps.explanation: Sign changes at both 0 and 2. f(0) = 10 and f(2) = 16 - 32 + 10 = -6.
steps.why: Both points are verified inflection points.
